title: Trump administration has spent nearly $4B to cancel offshore wind farms | TechCrunch
summary: The remaining $300 million will go toward buying natural gas turbines to power 15 peaking power plants around the country. Peaking power plants are among the most expensive and most polluting natural gas power plants to operate.
